Continuous 2D coordinate pos_mlp (Option A) + non-enclosing contiguous wedge masking + scan-centered L_inv fixes FM7/FM8/FM11
Patch-level shared energy normalization (patch_energy_norm, dim=(-2,-1)) preserves spatial contrast and restores Rivet_v2/Sizing without losing Chirp/TMR

Clean tokenizer + subspace norm (clean_phasor_token: peak-polarity alignment, 5 diffusion-energy quantiles, root-saliency complex phasors without +-pi branch cut; subspace_norm: separate LayerNorm for z_c and bias-free LayerNorm for z_s; repaired zc_cond grounding) removes FM16/FM17 on exp60 base

Decoupled Spatial Energy Contrast + Patch-Consistent Polarity Alignment (exp62 on exp60 base: relative_energy_anchor adds spatial flux ratio log(1+E_i)-log(1+E_context) to time branch without outer-ring boundary coupling, fixing FM11 on Rivet_v2 & Sizing without FM13/FM14; patch_polarity_align aligns polarity via center probe 0 without checkerboard flips or root-saliency spectral starvation, fixing TMR polarity while preserving broadband Dodd-Deeds phase)

Bi-directional Spatial Energy Contrast (exp63 on exp62 base: bi_directional_relative_energy appends signed Delta E and absolute magnitude |Delta E| to time branch; preserves directional sizing/depth cues while mapping both excess flux and deficit hole flux into positive anomaly subspace, eliminating Rivet_v2 PC1 sign inversion in latent space)

Green's Diffusion Attention Bias (diffusion_attention adds -exp(gamma_h)*||p_i - p_j||^2 to self/cross attention) enforces physical diffusion spatial decay, stabilizing latent effective rank (22.8D) but distorting covariance geometry for UDA alignment

Two-Stream Disentangled Backbone (two_stream_backbone decouples carrier and scattering streams from input with unidirectional z_c.detach() cross-attention modulation) achieves near-perfect in-domain discrimination (Val LP AUC 0.9805, Val Sizing R2 0.7262) and provides clean scattering covariance for UDA adaptation (CORAL/DANN +0.024 to 0.5668)

Grounded Condition Prediction with Unit-Sphere Transfer Function (grounded_condition_pred normalizes condition to S^{D-1} with scale-normalized cosine + shape loss) breaks multi-solution averaging, rescuing unseen TMR sensor (P1u jumps to 0.658) and setting new OOD benchmarks (Test P1u 0.6164, CDAN 0.5876)

Combined Two-Stream Backbone + Grounded Condition Prediction (EXP-65: two_stream_backbone decouples carrier and scattering streams in encoder while grounded_condition_pred normalizes condition to S^{D-1} with scale-normalized cosine + shape loss in predictor) achieves both peak in-domain discrimination (retaining scattering covariance structure) and robust zero-shot cross-condition generalization across unseen waveforms and sensors.

Harder Wedge Masking (EXP-66b: 15-target probe contiguous wedge masking, 60% masked) increases predictive task difficulty on unmasked sound metal, but without raw physical amplitude preservation, test linear probe remains at 0.6122 and UDA negative transfer persists across shifts.

Log-Energy Magnitude Coupling (EXP-66c: lambda_mag * |log(E_pred/E_tgt)| coupled with Cosine distance) attempts to restore physical scale under Cosine loss, but suffers optimization conflicts between angular alignment and log-energy ratio, degrading test LP to 0.6042 and causing severe UDA collapse on cross-waveform.

Self-Focus Error Weighting (EXP-66d: error-proportional weighting w_b in [0.2, 5.0] on high-prediction-error boundary tokens) sharpens defect boundaries, boosting Target LP on cross-waveform (0.6696 vs 0.5709 in 66b), but overall test LP plateaus at 0.6116 due to continued Invariance Gradient Hijack.
Dynamic Condition Token & Two-Stream Backbone under Raw L1 (EXP-67a: dynamic sound-metal reference sampling per scan + two-stream decoupled backbone + anti_hijack_ratio=0.25 on raw L1)

Static Condition Token & DISENTANGLED 2-subspace Backbone + subspace_norm under Raw L1 (EXP-67b: static sound-metal condition token + latent_disentanglement=true / unified_latent=null + subspace_norm=true + query_projection + self_focus_gamma=0.5 + anti_hijack_ratio=0.25 on raw L1). NOTE: unified_latent was NEVER enabled in this run, so this rejection does NOT cover the unified-latent hypothesis; both EXP-67 runs died of FM22 within 8-10 epochs and are uninformative about their own mechanisms.

Unified OPF-JEPA with Dodd-Deeds Spectral Conditioning & Scale-Invariant Normalized L1 (EXP-68 -> split into EXP-68A/68B). 68A = exp63 lineage + probe-wise normalized L1 (R_eff 40.18D, Test LP 0.5961, Maha 0.7216). 68B = single unified 64D latent + Dodd-Deeds 16D spectral phase AdaLN + normalized L1 (R_eff 61.81D, Test LP 0.5945, Maha 0.7311). Both halt FM22 collapse.

Seven-method UDA downstream suite (CORAL/DANN/DAN-MMD/CDAN/SHOT/OTDA/CBST as marginal-alignment regularizers on ONE shared residual adapter, target = 8 test scans pooled into 50k pixels) improves cross-condition AUC over a zero-shot linear probe. AUDIT 2026-10-21: rejected. 112 recorded cells (4 runs x 4 shifts x 7 methods) give mean delta AUC vs LP = -0.0399 (t(15)=-3.26, p=0.0052); 81/112 cells worse by >0.02; 24/112 significant (Wilcoxon n=8) of which only 4 positive, all in exp65/cross_waveform. A lambda=0 control on the exp65 checkpoint (same architecture, no alignment) shows alignment contributes |delta|<=0.009 (mean +0.0022) on all 4 shifts while the head alone swings AUC by -0.120..+0.128; the only positive cell (CORAL +0.1275) is matched by lambda=0 (+0.1327). The table measures head+BN luck, not adaptation.

Latent JEPA 64-D beats handcrafted raw/FFT features for cross-condition defect LP at native dimensionality (Protocol B: 4 matched axes, 27 target files each, source covers exactly the 27 combinations of the other 3 factors, no target file ever fitted). AUDIT 2026-10-22: rejected. LP mean over the 4 axes: raw 150-D 0.662, FFT 800-D 0.713, JEPA 64-D 0.615; FFT wins sensor (+0.111) and liftoff (+0.112), JEPA wins only specimen (+0.031). At a matched 64-D budget (PCA fitted on source) JEPA 0.615 beats FFT-PCA 0.544 but still loses to raw-PCA 0.635, so even the compression argument does not survive against time-domain amplitude statistics.

Per-scan unsupervised Mahalanobis on the JEPA latent beats a supervised linear probe (canonical bar: 0.713 vs 0.644). AUDIT 2026-10-22: rejected in the matched protocol. Trim-70% per-scan Mahalanobis, 4 axes x 27 target files: JEPA 0.610 vs JEPA LP 0.615 (tie; sensor +0.018, waveform +0.054, specimen -0.065, liftoff -0.028). Mahalanobis still beats every label-free readout on raw/FFT (0.530/0.584) and beats LP on raw/FFT by ~0.13, so the label-free readout works ONLY on the JEPA latent, but the 0.713-vs-0.644 margin was a protocol artifact of the 65-file pooled canonical set with 5% trimming.

c_B carries usable condition information: H_pred(H_ctx(A), c_B) predicts H_tgt(B) better with the correct c_B than with a c_B taken from a DIFFERENT condition. AUDIT 2026-10-22: rejected. exp66b: delta centered-cosine = +0.056/-0.102/+0.051/+0.058 with p=0.50/0.67/0.50/0.33 over 6 null conditions (sensor/waveform/liftoff/specimen); exp65 with 10 nulls: +0.026/+0.005/+0.025/+0.019, p=0.40/0.30/0.10/0.10. ||pred||/||tgt|| = 0.72 (exp66b) and 1.21 (exp65), so the prediction is not degenerate and the null test has power; on cross-waveform the CORRECT c_B is actively worse than a wrong one (relL1 1.32 > 1). Only exp65 and exp66b tested; exp67a/67b/68A/68B untested.

Unsupervised Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) Self-Calibration via Trimmed Background Whitening replaces neural UDA: Closed-form per-scan background estimation and symmetric shrinkage whitening eliminates condition transfer offsets and restores cross-domain flaw contrast without requiring minority defect oversampling or adversarial alignment.

Train-inference spatial token & pos_embed mismatch: ContextEncoder trained only on 16 outer probes (9..24) while pos_embed[0:9] received zero grad in Encoder (trained only in Predictor), yet extract_features feeds all 25 probes to ContextEncoder

LayerNorm DC-bias needle bypass of L_inv: when offset_weight=0 and scan_centered_inv=False (021809, exp52, exp53, exp56), context_encoder.norm.bias[32:] inflates (max 5.3-13.3) so raw cos=0.985-0.995 while scan-centered cos is only 0.034-0.111

Small-group sound-metal noise amplification: scan_id=pair_idx (112 pairs -> 2.28 samples/group in batch 256) with pool_var_weight=0.5 + offset_weight=0.005 forces patch-mean variance on uncorrelated sound noise, driving pred_loss 1.07->1.74 before L_inv starts at ep 15

Pretraining val leakage & metric blindness: PairedPECTDataset loads all 16 Base Domain scans (12 train + 4 val = 112 pairs); per-scan Mahalanobis val_auc is blind to cross-condition rotation; global batch R_eff (38.9D) hides within-scan z_s rank (2.57D in exp53 vs 7.21D in exp56)

Per-probe (dim=-1) temporal normalization erases within-patch spatial amplitude contrast ||x_center||/||x_ring||, degrading Rivet_v2 (0.592->0.486) and Sizing R2 (+0.238->-0.101) in exp53 and collapsing sizing (-5.07) in exp52

Rank-dependent ZCA whitening mismatch & carrier shortcut: on low within-scan rank (2.57D in exp53) full 64x64 ZCA needs s2=1e-2 shrinkage, whereas on high within-scan rank (7.21D in exp56) s2=1e-2 over-damps 2nd-7th scattering axes (P1u_s5=0.6114 > P1u=0.5893 >> P1u_s2=0.5425)

Outer-ring (r3=7px) boundary variance coupling in patch_energy_norm: shared 25-probe std divides center probe 0 by outer-ring edge/lift-off steps, doubling sound variance (0.011->0.021) and centroid drift (7.57->19.61) and hurting linear probe on Chirp/Gaussian (0.5301 vs MLP_p1 0.5834)

Local patch-median AGC washout of macroscopic defect interiors: C-scans are already global_peak normalized per file; dividing v_pp/energy_t/mag by per-patch 25-probe median std (std_med) acts as a local AGC filter (r2=4px) that forces energy_t ~ log(2) inside wide defects and removes (mean_t)^2 DC flux, dropping Test LP 0.5579->0.4973 and Val Sizing R2 0.5599->0.2921 in exp59a

Unconditioned scattering-only target bottleneck & batch-mean centering residual: zeroing H_ctx_c in predictor (predictor_scattering_only=True) while predicting cross-condition targets without condition_token forces target encoder z_s into a low-rank (2.64D vs 7.00D) intersection across waveforms, hurting Chirp LP (0.5146->0.4241) in exp59b

Stopband phase-wrap noise in tokenizer: raw phase=angle(X_k)/pi on harmonics with ~0 energy (Hall_Pot Gaussian k>=9: saliency<0.01%, phase_std 0.14-0.58; Square k>=11: phase_std up to 0.99) injects +-pi branch-cut noise that dominates freq_proj input; zeroing the raw-phase columns of exp60 freq_proj flips z1-z2 defect-pixel cosine on Hall_Air Gaussian from -0.16 to +0.35. TMR polarity (x->-x) is an additional uncancelled sign flip for time_proj

Dead condition path + shared LayerNorm: in every disentangled run exp47-exp60 predictor is called with condition_token=None and zc_cond target is c_b.detach(), so cond_proj receives no gradient (measured grad=None on exp60); shared LayerNorm(64) over [z_c,z_s] lets z_c dominate (preLN RMS 7-12 vs 4-6) and z_s post-LN std falls to 0.003-0.012 on Chirp vs 0.10 on Gaussian/Square

Broadband spectral phase starvation & bias-free subspace over-invariance: multiplying Fourier harmonics by root-saliency (clean_phasor_token) zeroes out 13/16 harmonic bins (saliency < 0.02%), destroying broadband Dodd-Deeds dispersion cues; bias-free LayerNorm(32) on z_s allows scan_centered_inv to drive inv_loss to 0.0508 (cos=0.95), collapsing rank from 34D to 10.9D and regressing Hall_Air LP 0.7015->0.5198 and Test LP 0.6082->0.5728 in exp61.

Unweighted energy magnitude dilution in temporal projection: appending absolute relative energy magnitude |Delta E| directly into time_proj alongside signed Delta E compresses relative feature variance of Dodd-Deeds phase and transient peak arrival on smooth planar plates, trading off Corrosion LP (0.7445->0.6345) and Rivet_v1 LP (0.8191->0.6945) while resolving Rivet_v2 sign inversion in exp63.

SHOT entropy minimization collapse on extreme class imbalance (98.8% sound metal): minimizing Shannon entropy on uncalibrated target domains collapses predictions to majority sound-metal class, dropping Test AUC by 0.03-0.10.

Invariance Gradient Hijack: auxiliary non-predictive objectives (L_inv, L_carrier, L_vicreg) dominate optimization gradients (>80%), starving predictive token reconstruction and decoupling training loss from downstream anomaly discrimination.

Anti-Hijack Auxiliary Loss Scale Death Spiral: capping auxiliary losses proportionally to prediction loss (L_aux <= ratio * L_pred) under unnormalized Raw L1 on 98.8% sound metal allows flat background prediction to drive L_pred -> 0.005, scaling down aux_scale by 99.76% and extinguishing VICReg gradients; representations collapse into low-variance flat needles (sound_var 0.25 -> 0.0002, R_eff 1.2D-3.5D) without learning flaw dynamics.

Unscaled UDA lambda / adaptation-vs-architecture confound: the 7 UDA methods use fixed lambdas (CORAL 1.0, DANN 0.1, DAN 0.5, CDAN 0.1, SHOT/OTDA/CBST 0.5) against auxiliary losses spanning 4 orders of magnitude, so the alignment term is 0.1% of the task loss for CORAL (1e-4 vs 0.27-0.86), 2-8% for DANN, ~10% for DAN/SHOT and 44% for CDAN (Domain 1.14, discriminator never converges); CORAL is therefore a no-op and the 7 methods reduce to 7 arbitrary regularization strengths. Compounded by scoring delta-AUC against a linear probe (different model class + preprocessing) with no lambda=0 control on the same head, and by adapting and scoring on the SAME 8 target scans transductively.

Amplitude invariance eats the dominant defect cue: tokenizer.py:8,25 instance-normalizes the temporal window ('energy_adaptive') and uses 'lift-off invariant normalized phase angle and log-magnitude', so the 64-D latent discards absolute amplitude, while the handcrafted raw baseline keeps v_pp and the FFT baseline keeps |rfft|. Absolute amplitude is the standard C-scan defect indicator, which is the most likely reason the JEPA latent loses cross-condition LP to 800-D FFT (0.615 vs 0.713) and why CORAL helps FFT (cross-waveform +0.144) but hurts the JEPA latent (-0.038): there is no amplitude left to align. UNVERIFIED as a causal claim - would need a retrain without amplitude normalization.

Protocol-dependence of the per-scan readout margin: the canonical 'maha 0.713 > LP 0.644' compares a label-free per-file statistic against a probe trained on 12 files, both measured over 65 pooled test files spanning all conditions, with 5% trimming on the full 72 900-pixel scan. Under the matched-axis protocol (27 files per axis, 10%-defect stratified sample, 70% trim) the same Mahalanobis is 0.610 vs LP 0.615. Any claim of the form 'readout X beats probe Y' must therefore be reported together with the target-set composition, the trim fraction and the probe training set, or it is indistinguishable from a protocol artifact.

Within-batch permutation is a void null for c_B: every patch in a batch is drawn from the SAME scan B, so all ref_b rows are identical and shuffling them leaves the condition token unchanged; the permutation test returns delta=0 by construction and falsely appears to confirm the null. A valid null must change the condition itself (use ref_b from a different scan while holding x_a and x_b fixed) and must be repeated over several donor conditions to obtain a distribution.
